newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rescue teams save stranded Russian fishermen.
newsitem.headline: Rescue teams save stranded Russian fishermen.

text.p: Rescue teams on Saturday saved fishermen from drifting ice floes on Ladoga Lake in northwestern Russia but officials said that the number of trapped people turned out considerably lower then mentioned in initial reports.
A duty officer in the Emergencies ministry said that helicopters picked 18 fishermen from floes which drifted away from the shore. Earlier another eight fishermen had been taken from floes on boats.
Itar-Tass news agency said earlier that up to 100 people had been stranded when the ice cracked and wind carried away big chunks of ice earlier on Saturday.
The duty officer said that rescue helicopters made several rounds in the area and could not see any more people on the floes.
"We believe all people have been safely picked up," he said.
Fishing on frozen rivers and lakes is a common pastime for Russians in winter.
